sources.snippet:
_Main article: Tamagotchi Paradise (Comic book) "Tamagotchi Paradise (Comic book)")_
Tamagotchi Paradise is a comic book series in May 3rd, 2025 on Free Comic Book Day. The series teased and promoted the Tamagotchi Paradise before its announcement, introducing the backstory and general gameplay of the device through a Tamagotchi Lab researcher's perspective. The first episode was released both physically and online while further episodes were released exclusively online. [...] 2x AAA batteries

Characters and Shells

 The Tamagotchi Paradise (たまごっちパラダイス _Tamagotchi Paradaisu_) is a color-screen virtual pet released by Bandai worldwide. It initially released on July 12th, 2025 in Japan, Australia, and parts of Europe, and released on August 1st, 2025 in North America. 
The key feature of the Tamagotchi Paradise is the turn dial, which is used for zooming in and out on the main screen and can also be used to scroll through options.

- [x] 

## Contents [...] The Tamagotchi Paradise is the first mainline release for a few things: 
       The first release where toddler and teen characters do not have "-tchi" at the end of their names.
